goal: Decouple canonical Product identity/classification from the legacy Recommendation category projection before any schema or runtime authority cutover.

structural_coupling_inventory.current_blocker: public.products.category is NOT NULL public.product_category, so a canonical Product cannot exist unless it is coerced into a legacy Recommendation category.

selected_target_model.no_legacy_projection_representation: NULL products.category plus NULL legacy_projection_key; canonical taxonomy assignment remains required

parity_semantics_after_decoupling.catalog_coverage: every Product must have exactly one canonical assignment for the active catalog taxonomy version
parity_semantics_after_decoupling.legacy_projection_exactness: every Product that declares a legacy projection must exactly match its legacy category/form projection
parity_semantics_after_decoupling.recommendation_admission: only Products independently authorized by the Recommendation admission path may enter scoring/ranking

staged_migration.name: preflight_freeze
staged_migration.description: Freeze consumer inventory, target representation, invariants, and rollback boundary.

staged_migration.name: compatibility_contract
staged_migration.description: Add repository migration/read contracts that explicitly distinguish canonical taxonomy from nullable legacy Recommendation projection; keep runtime authority legacy.

staged_migration.name: nullable_legacy_projection_schema
staged_migration.description: Drop NOT NULL from products.category only after exact-head CI and zero-null preflight; no business-row mutation.

staged_migration.name: canonical_taxonomy_aware_promotion
staged_migration.description: Permit structurally valid catalog-only Product promotion with canonical taxonomy assignment and NULL legacy category; never coerce an unprojectable term.

staged_migration.name: dual_read_no_leak_parity
staged_migration.description: Prove catalog-only Products do not leak into Recommendation and current admitted legacy corpus remains no-delta.

staged_migration.name: future_recommendation_authority_cutover
staged_migration.description: Separate later gate only; not authorized by DATA-TAXONOMY6.

rollback.before_any_null_category_product_exists: Verify category IS NULL count is zero, then restore products.category NOT NULL and revert compatibility code.
rollback.after_catalog_only_product_exists: Do not coerce or delete canonical Products. Roll back Recommendation consumer changes while preserving Product IDs, taxonomy assignments, Product Facts, Offers, and NULL legacy projections.
